title: Agenc Protocol: initialise the coordination config
summary: Initialise the Agenc protocol config. register_agent and create_task are paused on this production build until stamp_release_surface.
what: Agenc Protocol is a large Anchor 0.32 agent-coordination program (tasks, bids, disputes, skills, listings). This lesson covers only initialize_protocol, which writes a singleton config PDA after proving the caller is the upgrade authority and a second multisig owner has co-signed. The hosted IDL is a minimal hand-derived subset confirmed by the live transaction.
app_note: The page at /dapps/agenc-protocol/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console, with this devnet program id filled in. register_agent and create_task are listed but will fail with ProtocolPaused until stamp_release_surface.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/agenc-protocol/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. initialize_protocol is already done on this lab deployment.
try_steps.see: Program 2wAW3Ack… . Fetch the config PDA (seeds ["protocol"]) at BhScAVMz….
try_steps.ran: initialize_protocol sig 61Ce3EX7WFcPDf9qk5v2KmPKDBnsAHBoJkPxNvHgVrH2g1Dujy8Jnzsr5Mr376jJb6cYq6YG4hEN8wnvLBLvr81v wrote config with authority and treasury = lab wallet.

try_steps.do: A fresh initialize with dispute_threshold=0 should fail; a second initialize of this deployment should also fail because the config PDA already exists.

diagram: upgrade authority + second signer + ProgramData --initialize_protocol--> protocol config PDA ["protocol"]
instructions: register_agent and a large additional surface exist in the program but are not in this IDL
innovation: A broad agent coordination protocol whose bootstrap requires the upgrade authority plus a second signer and an explicit ProgramData check.
frontend: Generic Sol.College IDL console (initialize_protocol works; register_agent/create_task are paused).
exercises: Explain why ProgramData must be passed.
not_covered: register_agent failed with ProtocolPaused (production builds start paused until stamp_release_surface). create_task was not sent.
build: Anchor 0.32.1 program (~2.4 MiB), declared at 2wAW3AckaeU12VVmoGKYLMFgSEmR7AFcpvoCyQaCtM8i on devnet. IDL hand-derived subset, tx-confirmed.
student_outcome: Initialise or inspect the Agenc coordination config and state what this lesson covers versus the wider program surface.

learning_loop.objective: Initialise/inspect coordination config — then bound claims to this lesson’s slice.
learning_loop.predict_question: Agenc Protocol’s IDL lists tasks, bids, disputes, skills, and listings. This lesson focuses on initialise/config. What is honest after a successful initialize?

predict_options.label: You have demonstrated the full coordination lifecycle
You have demonstrated config initialisation/inspection — not full task/bid/dispute mastery
Initialize proves nothing because the IDL is large

learning_loop.predict_why: A large program surface is not the lesson scope. Initialise/config evidence supports only that slice; tasks/bids/disputes need their own demonstrations.
learning_loop.act: Open /dapps/agenc-protocol/ on Devnet. Initialise if available or fetch the existing coordination config from lab proofs. Record config fields and explicitly list what you are not claiming.
learning_loop.explain_question: Why is “the program can do disputes” not the same as “I demonstrated disputes”?
learning_loop.transfer: Write one sentence that correctly scopes this elective after initialize succeeds.
